claim: Patchline ships a multi-tenant agent isolation proof guaranteeing no cross-tenant data or action leakage. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the multi-tenant isolation claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-tenant-agent-isolation-gate`.
